description: Contract 3 preserves the financial reader floor and requires recovery freeze support in every API/worker before read-only restore inspection. Optional UAT health transport observation expires, requires the metrics credential, and returns nonce-bound peer digests only; bank acceptance gates are independent. Test issuer profiles are editable only in Local/UAT; branch/contact are frozen into the existing receipt-v1 issuer address, preserving snapshot readers. Production continues to use its approved deployment profile. An explicit UAT-only operator command prepares an atomic, audited merchandise fixture without bank configuration, financial effects, simulator routes or stock-reset retries.
